title.home: Korean Digital Government Services, Made Easy
footer.about: Step-by-step help with Korean digital government services for the foreign community in Korea.
footer.disclaimer: Disclaimer: We are an independent service providing guidance. Please always refer to the official government websites for the most current information.

home.whyBody: Our mission is to uplift the foreign community through reliable support. This project is community-focused, with grassroots connections with organizations such as the Paju Exodus Church and Immigrant Integration Center. Grounded in compassion, we strive to make government services accessible and to be a dependable resource for those navigating life far from home.

svc.title: Resources
svc.intro: We provide guides on two critical services: Visa & Immigration and Identification & Banking. Click on each category to quickly access each section.
visa.title: Visa & Immigration
visa.desc: This section provides a guide to HiKorea, the Korean Government’s official E-Government for Foreigners.
id.title: Identification & Banking
id.desc: This section provides information about proving your digital identity through Digital IDs and using online banking services.
st.hover: Hover over “**Information Lookup** (정보조회)” on the Top Menu
st.login: Log in using your **HiKorea ID** and **Password**
e9.title: Apply for E-9 Visa (Non-Professional Employment Visa)
e9.s4: Click on “**Application for Permission to Stay** (체류허가 신청)”
e9.s6: Enter your **Alien Registration Number**, **Employer’s Business Registration Number**, and **Confirmation of Employment**
status.title: Checking Visa Application Status
status.s4: A list labeled “**e-Application Status**” will appear with: **Application Type, Submission Date, Current Status, Downloadable Certificate (if applicable)**.
reentry.title: Apply for a Re-Entry Permit
reentry.s4: Click on “**Application for Re-Entry Permit** (재입국허가 신청)” and fill in **Departure and Return Dates, Reason for Travel, Passport Number,** and **Contact Info**.
address.title: Report a Change of Address
address.s4: Click on “**Report Change of Residence Address** (주소 변경 신고)” and fill in **Your Old Address, Your New Address, Date of Move**.
cert.title: Requesting a Digital Certificate (공동/금융인증서)
cert.s5: Enter your Name, Alien Registration Number (외국인등록번호), and Korean Mobile Number (must be registered under your name)
cert.s6: Select your telecom provider (SKT, KT, LG U+) and complete the SMS verification
cert.s7: Set a password for your certificate (8–15 characters, including letters, numbers, and symbols)
cert.s8: Choose where to save your certificate (PC hard drive, USB, or mobile phone via QR code transfer)
cert.s9: Click “**Issue Certificate**” to complete the process
selfid.title: Requesting a Self-Identification Certificate (본인확인서)
selfid.s1: Hover over “**Identity Verification Service** (본인확인서비스)” on the Top Menu
selfid.s3: Choose a login method: Mobile Phone (휴대폰), Digital Certificate (공동인증서), or Credit Card (신용카드)
selfid.s4: Complete identity verification using your selected method
selfid.s5: After logging in, review your verification history
selfid.s6: Click on “**Print Certificate** (확인서 출력)” next to the relevant entry
selfid.s7: Save or print the Self-Identification Certificate (본인확인서) as a PDF or hard copy
tax.title: Filing Taxes Online (홈택스)
tax.s1: Click on “**Log In** (로그인)” at the top right corner
tax.s3: Choose your Digital Certificate (공동인증서) and enter your password
tax.s4: Hover over “**Year-End Tax Settlement** (연말정산)” or “**My NTS** (My 홈택스)” on the Top Menu
tax.s6: Perform Self-Identification (본인인증) using your Digital Certificate (공동인증서) or Mobile Phone (휴대폰)
tax.s7: Review your income, insurance, and deduction records
tax.s8: Download or send the data to your employer by clicking “**Download File** (자료 내려받기)” or “**Send to Employer** (회사 제출)”
tax.s9: If filing independently, return to the Main Menu and click “**File Comprehensive Income Tax** (종합소득세 신고)”
tax.s10: Follow the on-screen instructions to enter additional data and complete submission
tax.s11: After submission, save or print your receipt from “**Submission Results** (신고내역조회)”
